operations.queryDocument: query EpicLCurrentAppScopes { currentAppInstallation { id accessScopes { handle } } }

pagination.completionRule: A single successful response is complete.

identityChecks: Do not treat scopes as store identity; run shop identity operation before accepting evidence.
redactionRules: Record scope handles only; omit tokens, headers, and environment values.
operations.failureDisposition: Record inaccessible or query failure; do not infer scopes or continue as complete.

operations.queryDocument: query EpicLShopIdentityAccountsPlan { shop { id name myshopifyDomain ianaTimezone plan { publicDisplayName shopifyPlus partnerDevelopment } customerAccounts customerAccountsV2 { customerAccountsVersion loginLinksVisibleOnStorefrontAndCheckout loginRequiredAtCheckout url } } }

pagination.completionRule: A single successful response matching the expected domain is complete.

identityChecks: Require shop.myshopifyDomain to equal sz5dnk-nf.myshopify.com before retaining any other audit evidence.
Record shop.id as the future immutable target identifier.
redactionRules: Do not record customer identities, login tokens, or authenticated account URLs containing secrets.
operations.failureDisposition: Stop the audit on an identity mismatch; record failure without retaining evidence from the wrong shop.

operations.queryDocument: query EpicLPages($first: Int!, $after: String) { pages(first: $first, after: $after, sortKey: UPDATED_AT) { nodes { id title handle isPublished createdAt updatedAt } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

pagination.completionRule: Follow endCursor until hasNextPage is false; any missing or repeated cursor is failure.

identityChecks: Shop identity must already be verified.
redactionRules: Do not persist page bodies or form submissions; retain only identity and publication metadata.
operations.failureDisposition: Mark the Pages capability incomplete on scope, transport, GraphQL, or pagination failure.

operations.queryDocument: query EpicLFiles($first: Int!, $after: String) { files(first: $first, after: $after, sortKey: UPDATED_AT) { nodes { id alt fileStatus createdAt updatedAt ... on GenericFile { url originalFileSize } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

pagination.completionRule: Follow endCursor until hasNextPage is false; any missing or repeated cursor is failure.

identityChecks: Shop identity must already be verified.
redactionRules: Do not download files or retain signed URLs, customer uploads, or document contents; inventory metadata only.
operations.failureDisposition: Mark the Files capability incomplete on scope, transport, GraphQL, type, or pagination failure.

operations.queryDocument: query EpicLPolicies { shop { shopPolicies { id type title url createdAt updatedAt } } }

pagination.completionRule: A single successful response is complete because shopPolicies is a list, not a connection.

identityChecks: Shop identity must already be verified.
redactionRules: Do not treat policy metadata or historical warranty-looking text as approved warranty authority; omit body text from the sanitized inventory.
operations.failureDisposition: Record policy metadata as inaccessible; do not infer policy absence or content.

operations.queryDocument: query EpicLAppInstallations($first: Int!, $after: String) { appInstallations(first: $first, after: $after, sortKey: INSTALLED_AT) { nodes { id app { id title handle shopifyDeveloped } accessScopes { handle } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

pagination.completionRule: Follow endCursor until hasNextPage is false; any missing or repeated cursor is failure.

identityChecks: Shop identity must already be verified.
redactionRules: Record app identity and scope handles only; omit tokens, launch URLs, billing data, and app-owned customer records.
operations.failureDisposition: Mark application inventory incomplete on scope, transport, GraphQL, or pagination failure.

operations.queryDocument: query EpicLThemes($first: Int!, $after: String) { themes(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id name role updatedAt } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

pagination.completionRule: Follow endCursor until hasNextPage is false; any missing or repeated cursor is failure.

identityChecks: Shop identity must already be verified.
Expected production and preview theme IDs are context only until observed.
redactionRules: Retain theme identity, role, name, and timestamp only; do not download or change theme files.
operations.failureDisposition: Mark theme inventory incomplete on scope, transport, GraphQL, or pagination failure.

operations.manualPath: Online Store > Themes > Customize > App embeds

pagination.completionRule: Capture a sanitized inventory or explicitly record inaccessible; do not toggle anything.

identityChecks: Confirm store and theme IDs before review.
redactionRules: Record app embed name and enabled state only; omit configuration values and credentials.
operations.failureDisposition: Record inaccessible or incomplete; do not infer disabled state.

pagination.completionRule: Inventory all visible forms and settings or explicitly record inaccessible; do not open submissions.

identityChecks: Confirm store identity in Admin before review.
redactionRules: Record form identity, status, field definitions, consent configuration, and automation links only; no submissions or customer values.
operations.failureDisposition: Record inaccessible or incomplete; do not infer absence or feasibility.

pagination.completionRule: Inventory all workflows or explicitly record inaccessible; do not enable, disable, or run workflows.

identityChecks: Confirm store identity in Admin before review.
redactionRules: Record workflow name, status, trigger/action types, and app dependencies only; omit run payloads and customer data.
operations.failureDisposition: Record inaccessible or incomplete; do not infer workflow coverage.

pagination.completionRule: Inventory capability and sanitized settings or explicitly record inaccessible; do not open conversations.

identityChecks: Confirm store identity in Admin before review.
redactionRules: Do not access or retain conversation transcripts, customer profiles, contact details, or message contents.
operations.failureDisposition: Record inaccessible or incomplete; do not infer support-channel readiness.

pagination.completionRule: Inventory all relevant automations or explicitly record inaccessible; do not activate or send.

identityChecks: Confirm store identity in Admin before review.
redactionRules: Record automation identity, status, trigger, audience rule, consent dependency, and channel only; omit recipients and message bodies.
operations.failureDisposition: Record inaccessible or incomplete; do not infer messaging or onboarding feasibility.

completionRules: Verify the exact myshopify domain before accepting any capability evidence.
Record observed time, API version or manual path, responsible auditor, and sanitized source reference for every operation.
Every required connection must end with hasNextPage false; cursor failure or a repeated cursor is an incomplete audit.
HTTP, GraphQL, permission, schema, identity, and manual-access failures remain failures and cannot be converted to empty successful results.
A missing operation or missing evidence reference prevents an overall successful audit disposition.
No query, review, or artifact may mutate Shopify, configure an app, access customer records, or approve a policy.
Plan and API version must be revalidated against current official Shopify documentation immediately before separately authorized execution.
